output_policy: Use the dedicated original r10 DIY stencil, never the EasyEDA generic GTP. Separate PCB and stencil deliveries. No back-paste process.
declared_generic_paste_differences: J501: EasyEDA omits four PTH shell paste windows from generic output; all connector pads are intentionally hand soldered and omitted from the dedicated stencil.
U803: exact circular arcs replace the KiCad custom-pad fractured polygon; generic ring boundary differs by up to 0.004729 mm. Dedicated DIY steel keeps its independently reviewed bridged geometry.
U203: source serialization shift below 0.000005 mm; all other reference outlines agree within numeric precision.
limits: Actual raw EasyEDA and native paste shape differences are enumerated, not treated as zero merely because DRC passes.
An annular generic Gerber drawn as four touching sectors is still a full ring with an unsupported steel island; only the dedicated stencil has four 0.15 mm bridges.
First-board print/reflow, stencil thickness/cutting capability, and acoustic sealing remain physical checks.
Top silkscreen equality is against the audited repaired1 EasyEDA output, not a claim of KiCad font/plot identity.
Final-stage paste proof chains the full repaired1 geometry audit to exact unchanged operation geometry; no expensive full polygon rerender was repeated.
